name: M25 Magnetic Speaker Wireless Bluetooth Speaker Dazzling Split Subwoofer Wireless Bluetooth Audio RGB
description:
Magnetic Speaker 🔊

Experience powerful sound and stunning lights with this Wireless Bluetooth Audio System, designed for both indoor and outdoor fun! The 2-in-1 magnetic design lets you use it as a single full-range speaker or split it into two stereo units for an immersive sound experience.
